search.label: Product search korun
search.placeholder: Ki khujchen? Jemon chal, tel, saban

footer.payment: Payment: cash on delivery. Dispatch-er age store apnar order confirm korbe.
footer.contactPending: Setup shesh hole store-er contact details ekhane dekhabe.

setup.title: Setup baki
setup.body: Store-er setup ekhono shesh hoyni, tai ekhon kono product dekhano jacche na.

ownerBody.not_configured: Database ekhono connect kora hoyni. Setup-er dhap-gulo project-er README.md file-e ache.
ownerBody.unreachable: Database configure kora ache, kintu server seta-te pouchate parche na. MONGODB_URI ar database-er network access list check korun.
ownerBody.not_replica_set: Database-e pouchano jacche, kintu eta replica set na, tai order nirapode save kora jabe na. MongoDB Atlas cluster ba single-node replica set use korun.
ownerBody.connected: Database connected. Store-er settings ar owner account ekhono toiri hoyni.

notFound.title: Page-ti paowa jayni
notFound.body: Link-ti bhul hote pare, ba page-ti shoriye neya hoyeche.

error.title: Kichu ekta shomossha hoyeche
error.body: Ei page-ti ekhon dekhano jacche na. Ektu por abar try korun.

maintenance.title: Maintenance cholche
maintenance.body: Store kichukkhoner jonno bondho ache. Ektu por abar ashun.

offline.title: Internet connection nei
offline.body: Connection fire ele page-ti reload korun.

errors.accounts_unavailable: Ei store-e ekhono account chalu hoyni. Pore abar try korun.
errors.rate_limited: Onekbar try kora hoyeche. Kichukkhon por abar try korun.
errors.limits_unavailable: Login protection ekhon kaj korche na, tai ei kaj-ti apatoto bondho. Pore abar try korun.
errors.email_not_verified: Age email verify korun. Pathano link-ti khulun, ba niche theke notun link chan.
errors.invalid_credentials: Ei email ar password diye kono account paowa jayni.
errors.two_factor_expired: Login-er ei dhap-er shomoy shesh. Abar login korun.
errors.two_factor_locked: Onekbar bhul code deya hoyeche. Abar login korun.
errors.email_unavailable: Ei store ekhono email pathate pare na, tai ei kaj-ti kora jacche na. Store-er sathe jogajog korun.
errors.try_again: Kichu ekta shomossha hoyeche. Abar try korun.
errors.reset_link_invalid: Ei reset link-ti thik na ba meyad shesh. Notun link chan.
errors.signed_out: Apnar session shesh hoyeche. Abar login korun.
errors.two_factor_required_by_role: Apnar staff role-e two-step verification lagbe, tai eta bondho kora jabe na.
errors.setup_done: This store already has an owner. Sign in instead.
errors.step_up_required: Confirm with a code from your authenticator app first.
errors.forbidden: Apnar role-e ei kaj-ti korar permission nei.
errors.staff_user_not_found: No account uses that email. Ask the person to create an account and verify their email first.
errors.staff_user_not_verified: That account has not verified its email yet.
errors.staff_last_owner: The store must keep at least one owner.
errors.staff_self_target: You cannot do this to your own account.
errors.catalogue_not_found: That record no longer exists. Reload the page.
errors.catalogue_version_conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. Reload the page to see the latest version, then try again.
errors.catalogue_slug_taken: Another record already uses this web address.
errors.catalogue_slug_locked: The web address cannot change after the first publish.
errors.catalogue_sku_taken: Another variant already uses this SKU.
errors.catalogue_parent_not_found: The chosen parent category no longer exists.
errors.catalogue_depth_exceeded: Categories can be at most three levels deep.
errors.catalogue_cycle: A category cannot be moved under itself or its own sub-category.
errors.catalogue_parent_has_products: The chosen parent holds products. Only the lowest level can hold products.
errors.catalogue_parent_unpublished: Publish what this shows first (its parent, collection or banner).
errors.catalogue_has_children: This category has sub-categories. Move or delete them first.
errors.catalogue_category_not_leaf: Choose a lowest-level category; this one has sub-categories.
errors.catalogue_category_not_found: A chosen category no longer exists.
errors.catalogue_no_sellable_variant: Add an active variant with a price before publishing.
errors.catalogue_compare_at_not_higher: The compare-at price must be higher than the price.
errors.catalogue_sample_publish_blocked: Sample data cannot be published in this database.
errors.catalogue_in_use: This is in use (published before, or has stock history), so it cannot be deleted. Archive it instead.
errors.catalogue_insufficient_stock: That would take stock below zero or below what is reserved for orders.
errors.catalogue_idempotency_key_reused: This form was already used for a different change. Reload the page and try again.
errors.catalogue_invalid: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.

fieldErrors.setup_token_wrong: The setup token does not match
fieldErrors.email_taken_setup: An account already uses this email. Use another email for the owner
fieldErrors.slug_invalid: Use lower-case Latin letters, digits and single hyphens (2–80 characters)
fieldErrors.attribute_line: Each line needs at least key | label | value; the key uses lower-case letters, digits and _
fieldErrors.sku_invalid: Use capital letters, digits and hyphens (2–64 characters)
fieldErrors.price_invalid: Enter an amount in taka, e.g. 425 or 425.50
fieldErrors.compare_at_not_higher: Must be higher than the price
fieldErrors.barcode_invalid: Use letters, digits and hyphens only
fieldErrors.qty_positive: Enter a whole number above zero
fieldErrors.qty_nonzero: Enter a whole number other than zero
fieldErrors.internal_path: Use a path inside the store starting with /, e.g. /c/rice
fieldErrors.accent_contrast: This colour is too light on the page background. Choose a darker one
fieldErrors.zone_taken: A zone already uses this code

success.check_inbox: Inbox check korun. Ei address-e email gele ekta verification link ashche; kokhono kichu minute lage. Account chalu korte link-ti khulun.
success.verification_resent: Ei address-e kono unverified account thakle notun verification link ashche.
success.reset_requested: Ei email-e account thakle password reset link ashche. Link-ti 1 ghontar moddhe, shudhu ekbar kaj korbe.
success.password_reset: Apnar password bodlano hoyeche, ar shob device theke logout kora hoyeche. Notun password diye login korun.
success.password_changed: Password bodlano hoyeche. Apnar onno session-gulo logout kora hoyeche.
success.sessions_revoked: Apnar onno shob session logout kora hoyeche.
success.two_factor_started: Apnar authenticator app-e HorekBazar add korun, tarpor app-e dekhano 6 digit-er code din.
success.two_factor_enabled: Two-step verification chalu. Apnar onno session-gulo logout kora hoyeche.
success.two_factor_disabled: Two-step verification bondho. Apnar onno session-gulo logout kora hoyeche.
success.owner_created: Owner account created. Check your inbox and open the verification link, then sign in and turn on two-step verification.
success.staff_saved: Staff role saved. Their sessions were signed out so the change applies at once.
success.staff_removed: Staff access removed. Their sessions were signed out.
success.staff_two_factor_reset: Two-step verification was reset. They must set it up again at their next sign-in.
success.inventory_replayed: This change was already saved; nothing was counted twice.

auth.name: Apnar naam
auth.passwordHint: Kompokkhe 10 character. Choto ekta bakko mone rakha shohoj.
auth.unavailableBody: Ei store-e account setup ekhono shesh hoyni. Tobe apni product dekhte paren.

login.title: Login
login.googleUnavailable: Google login ekhon kaj korche na.
login.googleFailed: Google login shesh hoyni. Abar try korun.

twoFactor.title: Two-step verification
twoFactor.backupBody: Protiti backup code ekbar-i kaj kore.

register.title: Notun account khulun
register.description: Order track korte ar address save korte HorekBazar account khulun.
register.emailOff: Ei store ekhono email pathate pare na, tai notun account verify kora jacche na. Pore abar try korun.

forgot.title: Password reset korun
forgot.description: Notun password dite ekta link nin.
forgot.body: Apnar account-er email din. Notun password dewar link amra pathiye debo.

reset.title: Notun password din
reset.description: Apnar account-er jonno notun password din.
reset.missing: Ei page-e reset email-er link-ti lagbe.

verify.title: Email verify korun
verify.ok: Apnar email verify hoyeche. Ekhon login korte paren.
verify.failed: Ei verification link-ti thik na ba meyad shesh.
verify.missing: Address verify korte verification email-er link-ti khulun.

account.title: Amar Account
account.ordersBody: Store order neya shuru korle apnar shob order ekhane dekhabe.
account.addressesBody: Checkout chalu hole delivery address save korte parben.

profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Naam
profile.phoneHint: Optional. Order confirm korte store ei number-e call korbe.
profile.emailNote: Login email ekhane ekhono bodlano jay na.

security.title: Security
security.noPassword: Apni Google diye login koren, tai ekhane ei account-er kono password nei.
security.twoFactorOn: Chalu. Login korte authenticator app-er code lagbe.
security.twoFactorOff: Bondho. Chalu korun, jate shudhu password churi hole keu login korte na pare.
security.twoFactorRequired: Apnar staff role-e two-step verification lagbe. Admin-e jete eta setup korun.
security.secretHint: Apnar authenticator app-e (jemon Google Authenticator ba Microsoft Authenticator) Enter a setup key bechhe nin, tarpor ei key-ti likhun. Phone-e nicher link-tio khulte paren.
security.backupBody: Egulo ekhon-i nirapod kothao rakhun. Phone harale protiti code ekbar kaj korbe. Egulo ar dekhano hobe na.
